name: Surrendering
overview: Surrendering in Scripture calls believers to fully trust and depend on the Lord rather than their own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 urges. Jesus exemplifies this surrender by instructing His followers to deny themselves, take up their cross, and follow Him (Matthew 16:24). This act of surrender is a holy offering of our lives to God, described in Romans 12:1 as presenting ourselves as living sacrifices. Moreover, James 4:8 encourages drawing near to God through cleansing and purification of heart, reflecting the inward transformation that accompanies true surrender, while Psalms 9:10 assures that those who seek God in this way will not be forsaken.
